title: Venetian Bronze Soap Dish, 4.5-Inch Wall-Mount Solid Brass Bathroom Holder, Dottingham Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Venetian Bronze, wall mounted soap dish, 4.5 in L x 3 in H x 3.5 in W with 5 in projection, solid brass bathroom soap holder designed to keep countertops clean and clutter free, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Traditional/transitional styling with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look; wall mount installation uses space efficiently. Includes brass soap dish holder and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Supports up to 2 lb. Product weight 1.6 lb. Ideal for transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware layouts, including beaded bathroom hardware looks; coordinate matching Dottingham pieces for a unified bathroom. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Dottingham collection.
